title: Spring TL
body:
# A fresh, fast, and beautiful Minecraft 1.21.5 experience

Sprng is a performance-focused modpack designed to make Minecraft feel lighter, smoother, and more alive — without sacrificing visual charm or gameplay depth
Whether you're on a low-end machine or just want a cleaner experience, this pack delivers silky performance and vibrant aesthetics in perfect harmony

## ⚙️ Core optimizations
- Sodium
- Sodium extra
- Lithium
- ImmediatelyFast
## ⚡️ Targeted optimizations
- C^2ME
- Noisium
- Ferrite core
- Audition
- Fast math
- Krypton
## 🌊 Culling optimizations
- Entity culling
- More culling

## 🔧 Compatibility
- Fabric API
- Iris
- OptiGUI
- EMF & ETF & ESF
- Continuity
- Paxi

## 🌎 World generation
- Terralith
- Incendium
- Seasons
## 🗝️ Tools & tweaks
- Mod menu
- Zoomify
- Orthographic camera
- Xaero's map & minimap
## 💸 QoL features
- Timber
- Veinminer
- Smart farmer

## 🎨 Resource packs
- Faithful 32x
- Colourful containers
- Fresh animations (with 32x patch!)
## 🌈 Shaders
- MakeUp
- BSL
- Complementary
